source.label: McDonald et al. (2017), Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society 471 770-791

McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: distance 113.25 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.025), at which the luminosity and radius hold

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from its measured spectrum. The disc itself is unresolved; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere.
controls.notes: The color of the star's measured spectrum (Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 780). The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,199 K and log g 1.75 (u1 0.869, u2 -0.040): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
